scripts.test:build: npm run build && vitest run --project build
scripts.test:pwa: npm run build:pwa && playwright test --project pwa
scripts.test:tv: npm run build:tizen && playwright test --project tv
scripts.check: npm run build && vitest run && playwright test
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run test:tizen
scripts.test-deploy: npm run check && scp dist/pwa/* ctrldash.app:/www/ctrldash/music/test/
scripts.package:tizen: npm run build:tizen && ${TIZEN_STUDIO:-$HOME/tizen-studio}/tools/ide/bin/tizen package -t wgt -- dist/tizen && mv 'dist/tizen/Ctrl music.wgt' dist/tizen/CtrlMusic.wgt
